execution: Only the shared successor C275 environment; no production or second application environment.

browser.open: open({actor,am,agentId?}) => {page,origin,switchAM(nextAm),close()}; real compiled Playwright page with isolated cookies; named roles must not fall back to admin.
browser.evidence: evidence(page) => shared multi-am-browser-evidence-v1 actual request IDs/AM and compiled_manifest/owner_proof; retain via ctx.observe; no raw credential or path required.

admin-fixtures.take: take(name,ctx) returns an owned setup with scope=LOCAL_DISPOSABLE_TWO_AM, cleanup() and the data/methods listed below. Register cleanup immediately. Missing setup must throw Blocked, never return a pass oracle.

methods.revoke: revoke(actor,capability) => restoration callback; change actual local auth provider authorization, no fabricated HTTP response

requirements: Known allocation history across at least two owners and runtime images
At least 51 choices/rows for actual UI cursor traversal where requested
Duplicate owner names with separately authorized directory context
Unavailable measured points and nonzero infrastructure-only quantities
Fresh exact expected totals for each requested time window; truth derives from fixture seed, not report responses
Per-case fresh setup; named roles names_operator/directory_operator differ only read_user_directory and both have read_all_sandboxes/read_operator_activity
ADM020 has measured_visible=true, deterministic 51+ frozen sandbox rows including ties
ADM021 has more than 20 owners and partial allocation history
ADM016/017/018 each needs 51+ actual discoverable choices for its kind, with duplicate names and stable IDs
Truth values derive from seeded/observed allocation intervals; report response must not define its own expected value

methods.legacyTotalsAt: legacyTotalsAt(as_of,owner?,sandbox_id?) => allocation quantities computed from known fixture intervals; no report-response inputs
methods.revokeDirectory: revokeDirectory(actor) => restore callback; actual local auth capability revision, never mock AM response

methods.arm: arm({kind,method,path,am?}) => {release(),close(),observations()}; local forwarding proxy or real configuration fault only; kinds include hold_response, drop_accepted_response, disabled_view, busy, unavailable, expire_report. Preserve the real upstream result and source/request identity. Request selector is exact method/path; support hold_request/hold_response/drop_accepted_response/disabled_view/busy/unavailable/expire_report and /admin/warm-pools plus retirement. observations() returns actual ordered upstream method/path/status/body/idempotency_sha256/request_id and accepted effect identity; NEVER a test verdict. Optional query selector and retry_after_seconds; observations include observed_ms and request_body; release stops applying fault while continuing its observation journal. Hold only selected matching requests, never unrelated requests.

requirements: No synthetic success report
Observe upstream acceptance before dropping a mutation response
Restore every injected fault on failure

data: events include failure and transition examples with seq/at
runtime_operator observes at least one actual starting/ready/unavailable generation

methods.observeProvider: Read-only actual native resource/home identity and finality
methods.workWitness: Read actual already-running work state; no new side effects
methods.replayAdmission: Replay the retained original public admission using its same immutable key/body and return the HTTP receipt
methods.audit: audit({target,action}) => actual public activity rows; preserve actor/outcome/request identity
methods.tryUseProfile: tryUseProfile(profile) => actual public create/admission result; setup owns any unexpected created resource cleanup
methods.releaseWork: Release existing local held provider turn only; source-controlled runtime then applies queued update

requirements: Public-created disposable cross-owner Sandbox and all profile kinds
Older immutable runtime with real upgrade available and active work
Known sandbox event history spans more than 50 events
Parent owns cleanup custody immediately after resource creation

methods.observeProvider: Actual spare and claimed runtime identities/counts; distinguish desired, pending and Ready
methods.claimedAgentWitness: Read existing Agent state/reply continuity through public APIs

requirements: Exclusive local platform mutation lease
Unique capacity tuple, at most one spare
Both current and previous-image pools
Cleanup sets only owned pool targets to zero with fresh CAS and verifies provider finality

methods.login: login(session,actor) drives actual local auth provider login on existing Page; never bearer/storage/session substitution

requirements: Actual cookie-based sessions; browser evidence authentication=browser_session
Other principal has no Operations capabilities; original delayed response retained for cancellation proof

limits: Fixture definitions are requirements, not runtime bindings or PASS claims
All API calls and cleanup retain original uncertainty; never silently retry with a new key
At least two seconds between explicit report/lifecycle polls
